_meta.purpose: Maximum units of a code that are plausible for one patient on one date of service. Exceeding the limit is the single most common way a keying error turns into a four-figure charge.
_meta.note: Modelled on the CMS Medically Unlikely Edits (MUE) file, which is published quarterly and free to download. The values here are conservative placeholders so the engine works before that file is loaded. See docs/reference-data.md.
